description: Madamas Waterfall is a scenic waterfall nestled in Trinidad's northern range, accessible via an adventurous hike from the village of Brasso Seco. Surrounded by lush greenery and untouched natural beauty, the waterfall offers a refreshing escape into nature with a cool clear pool at its base. Listed opening hours: 24 Hours. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
